verdict.rationale: E2B's GitHub repo describes itself as open-source infrastructure and points to a self-hosting guide that deploys the infrastructure with Terraform. The SDK docs also explicitly support configuring clients for self-hosted deployments. missing for 10: the self-hosting guide's actual contents (supported clouds, requirements, feature parity with the hosted service) and any independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Read the self-hosting guide to learn how to set up the E2B infrastructure on your own. The infrastructure is deployed using Terraform.
E2B is an open-source infrastructure that allows you to run AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud.
If you need an explicit configuration — for example several API keys, teams, or BYOC or self-hosted deployments — create an `E2B` client and use the resources it exposes.
